reason: The query string only picks how the e-mail link is checked (token_hash or PKCE code). Supabase Auth verifies the token on both paths and the user gets a session only when that check passes, so nothing is bypassed.

Test helper only. It builds a password-locked PDF for the reader tests, and the PDF standard security handler (PDF 1.7, algorithms 2 to 4) is defined with MD5 and RC4. No user password is stored or hashed.
